Name: (CP) Thomas the Tank Engine Dwarves
Author: Mady0
Description:
[color=#ff0000][size=5][b]All games deserve at least one Thomas the Tank Engine mod.[/b][/size][size=4][b]
[/b][/size][/color][size=3]Upon seeing Stardew Valley had none, I had to do something!*

[/size][color=#ff0000][size=5][b]Introducing[/b][/size][/color][b][color=#ff0000][size=5] Tank Engine Dwarves![/size][/color][/b]
[size=3]Turn your dwarves into Thomas the Tank Engine.[/size]

[url=https://ibb.co/84KSKYQf][img]https://i.ibb.co/dJWzWmHV/Screenshot-2025-05-21-041143x2.png[/img][/url]
[size=1]*There already is a mod, I just missed it in my brief search. I am having fun with my mod and will be continuing it, but I am [i]now[/i] aware I am not the first.[/size]

[color=#ff0000][size=5][b]1.1.0 Update:
[/b][/size][/color][size=3]With the 1.1.0 update, the dwarf and [i]most[/i] dwarven items have been renamed to 'Thomas' and 'Tank Engine' respectively. The dwarf's birthday is also changed to Spring 12th to be more consistent with Thomas the Tank Engine's birthday.
Most of the code for this update came from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13515?tab=description]Renamed Dwarves[/url]﻿ then I adapted it. I also used [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9271]Ultimate Villager Manager[/url]﻿ to help me fix the small parts I wrote.
[/size]
